categories.name: 数学推理
categories.brief: 考数学推理的深度与严谨。一题让 Lean 内核逐步核验证明，一题不借助任何计算工具写出竞赛解答。
categories.brief_en: Depth and rigor in mathematical reasoning: one task has the Lean kernel check every proof step, the other asks for olympiad solutions written without any computational aid.

tasks.brief: 用 Lean 4 + Mathlib 为八道经典定理或研究论文中的定理写出形式化证明，能证几道算几道。
tasks.brief_en: Write Lean 4 + Mathlib formal proofs for eight theorems, classic or taken from research papers; every proof that compiles counts.

tasks.brief: 不借助任何计算工具，为十八道原创竞赛题写出符合数学竞赛作答规格的中文解答。
tasks.brief_en: Without any computational tools, write competition-standard solutions, in Chinese, to eighteen original olympiad problems.
tasks.deliverable: 答案\第01题.md–第18题.md：每题一个文件
tasks.deliverable_en: 答案\第01题.md–第18题.md, one file per problem

categories.name: 算法竞赛
categories.brief: 考硬指标下的搜索与优化工程。极值构造题比构造质量，以参考构造值为满分线；两道性能题比速度，与基线同场运行比加速比。
categories.brief_en: Search and optimization engineering against hard metrics: the extremal construction is judged by its quality against a reference value, the two performance tasks by their speedup over a baseline run side by side.

tasks.source: 单位正方形内最小三角形面积最大化
tasks.name_en: Maximizing the Smallest Triangle in a Unit Square
tasks.brief: 在单位正方形内放一组点，让任意三点构成的最小三角形面积尽可能大。
tasks.brief_en: Place a set of points in the unit square so that the smallest triangle formed by any three of them is as large as possible.

tasks.brief: 用 CUDA 在 RTX 4080 上实现 Transformer 的前向计算，结果在容差内，越快越好。
tasks.brief_en: Implement a Transformer forward pass in CUDA on an RTX 4080, within tolerance and as fast as possible.

tasks.source: 通用数字电路仿真器加速
tasks.name_en: Accelerating a General Digital Circuit Simulator
tasks.brief: 在 CPU 上仿真一个大规模同步时序电路，对大量随机激励逐周期算出输出摘要，越快越好。
tasks.brief_en: Simulate a large synchronous sequential circuit on the CPU, computing cycle-by-cycle output digests for many random stimuli, as fast as possible.

categories.name: 空间推理
categories.brief: 考三维空间推理：只凭零件的精确结构推演平移和相互阻挡，写出完整的拆解路线，不借助程序搜索。
categories.brief_en: 3D spatial reasoning: from the exact shapes of the pieces alone, work out their translations and blocking and write a complete disassembly route, without any program search.

tasks.brief: 给出八副已经装好的鲁班锁，根据零件的精确结构和初始位置，把每副锁完整拆成独立零件，步数尽量少。
tasks.brief_en: Given eight assembled Luban locks with the exact shape and starting position of every piece, take each lock fully apart into single pieces in as few moves as possible.
tasks.deliverable: 答案\第01题.json–第08题.json：每题一棵拆解树
tasks.deliverable_en: 答案\第01题.json–第08题.json, one disassembly tree per puzzle

categories.name: 复杂交互应用
categories.brief: 考搭建一款大型专业工具：几十项功能任意组合时结果仍正确、各视图始终一致。
categories.brief_en: Building a large professional tool: dozens of features stay correct in any combination and every view stays in sync.

tasks.brief: 制作可编辑的三维动效设计工具，把程序几何、网格变形、光影、粒子和时间效果接成真实链路，再用它完成一段 15 秒、带配乐的专业视觉动效。
tasks.brief_en: Build an editable 3D motion design tool that wires procedural geometry, mesh deformation, lighting, particles and time effects into real pipelines, then use it to make a professional 15-second motion piece with music.

categories.name: 游戏设计与开发
categories.brief: 考三维游戏的美术和设计思路：题面给定网络安全世界观和核心玩法，造型、配色和具体设计由模型定，场景、动画、特效和界面都要做出尽可能好的效果。
categories.brief_en: Art and design thinking in a 3D game: the brief fixes a cybersecurity setting and the core mechanics, the model decides the look, colors and details, and scenes, animation, effects and UI should all be as good as it can make them.

tasks.brief: 做一款三维塔防《网络安全攻防战》：隔离网络节点逼敌人改道，部分敌人会攻击塔，塔被摧毁后设备旁路直通，路线随之改变。
tasks.brief_en: Make a 3D cybersecurity tower defense game: isolating network nodes forces enemies to reroute, some enemies attack towers, and a destroyed tower leaves its device in bypass, so the routes change again.

categories.name: 物理模拟
categories.brief: 考三维物理模拟作品：可以用现成物理库，选哪个由模型自己决定。软体、刚体和流体的相互作用要有说服力，动态连贯，画面清晰。
categories.brief_en: A 3D physics simulation piece: an existing physics library may be used, and the model picks which. Soft bodies, rigid bodies and fluid must interact convincingly, move coherently and read clearly on screen.

tasks.brief: 在网页里做两个三维物理模拟场景：重球冲击果冻台，以及同尺寸多密度球在透明造浪水槽中的浮沉与运动。
tasks.brief_en: Build two 3D physics scenes in the browser: a heavy ball striking a jelly block, and equal-sized balls of different densities floating, sinking and moving in a transparent wave tank.

categories.name: 视觉设计与渲染
categories.brief: 考实时图形的技术与审美：一题是滚动驱动的网页艺术，一题是三渲二的微缩三维场景。两题的流畅度和帧率都不计分。
categories.brief_en: Technique and taste in real-time graphics: one task is scroll-driven web art, the other a toon-shaded 3D miniature. Smoothness and frame rate are not scored in either.

tasks.brief: 以 NVIDIA B200 为题材，制作一件可滚动、可交互的网页艺术作品。从完整封装进入结构、显存与数值，再拉远到多卡系统，最后回到整颗 GPU。
tasks.brief_en: Create a scrollable, interactive piece of web art about the NVIDIA B200: from the full package into its structure, memory and number formats, out to multi-GPU systems, and back to the whole GPU.

tasks.brief: 用 Three.js 做一件三渲二风格的微缩三维模型：太阳雨中的日式小渔港堤岸，没有人物和界面，可以自由旋转、缩放细看。
tasks.brief_en: Build a toon-shaded 3D miniature in Three.js: a small Japanese fishing-harbor embankment in a sunshower, with no people or UI, free to rotate and zoom in for detail.

categories.name: 系统架构与实现
categories.brief: 考一套实际运转的递归系统：子系统的内核本身就是被调度、被计费、可修改的程序，消息、文件、窗口和数据都跨层成立，在快照恢复和独立分叉后依然成立。
categories.brief_en: A recursive system that actually runs: each child system's kernel is itself a scheduled, metered, editable program, and messages, files, windows and data work across levels and still hold after snapshots, restores and forks.

tasks.brief: 做一个桌面端的嵌套图形操作系统：系统里还能启动系统，形成至少四层的系统树；子系统的内核是父系统里被调度、可修改的程序。根系统电子表格的数据实时画成子系统图表，子系统播放三维直升机起飞和坠机的演出，也能交互排演飞行，图表和播放器都能把可交互的窗口投送到祖先桌面。
tasks.brief_en: Build a nested graphical desktop OS: systems launch systems, forming a tree at least four levels deep, and each child's kernel is a scheduled, editable program inside its parent. Spreadsheet data in the root system feeds live charts in child systems, a child plays a 3D helicopter takeoff-and-crash sequence and lets you rehearse flights interactively, and both the charts and the player can project interactive windows onto ancestor desktops.
tasks.deliverable: Windows 桌面项目，单一启动入口
tasks.deliverable_en: Windows desktop project, single launch entry
